fonts.display: 'Matter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Matter Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Primary text, hairline borders, navigation outlines — the structural ink

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Page highlights, card surfaces, text on dark surfaces, button outlines

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Filled button background, footer surface, dark UI blocks — warm near-black replacing pure black for non-text surfaces

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Dominant page canvas, muted dividers, secondary surface tone
